summary: read check runs only in the implement watch
pull_request_body: This change makes the implement watch read check runs only without calling the commit status API.
why: Issue #2877: The implement job watches checks through read_commit_checks which calls the commit status endpoint. The App token has no statuses permission, so a refusal stops the item.
existing_tool: No external tool covers this need. `read_check_runs` already covers this.

decisions.reason: It reads check runs only and does not call the commit status API.

added.name: Watch reads check runs only
added.text: The implement job watch SHALL read check runs only.

scenarios.name: Watch calls read_check_runs
scenarios.when: The implement job watch reads checks

groups.title: Use read_check_runs in the watch
groups.test: Add a test in tests/github/test_check_verdict.py for watch_pull reading check runs only
groups.verify: uv run devops ci test tests/github/test_check_verdict.py

criteria.criterion: The watch reads the check runs only, with `read_check_runs` (added by #2865), or the App gets the permission (only a person may decide that). A test shows the choice.
